item.description:
### Emergency Pass
A way out when you genuinely need one. Hold the button to release blocking for a short window, then everything snaps back on its own — no waiting, no undoing your setup. A banner stays on screen while it runs so the pause is never something you forget about.
Blocks your organisation or parent set stay in force throughout.
### A new version no longer waits in silence
When an update is ready while you are working elsewhere, the Mac tells you.
### Picking "Pause again after" works
The Pause Before Opening interval opened an empty menu with no choices in it. It is now a proper sheet, like Appearance.
### Smaller fixes
- The PIN screen is legible in Light Mode. - Home cards — Pin Code, Emergency Pass, Safe Internet, Protection — match each other again. - Setup and result sheets no longer clip at the bottom edge. - Onboarding and Habits say "Mac" instead of "phone". - Report Site points at the current form.
